entries.title: Onto / hotel stories
entries.summary: An external OntoLang-style prelude: typed hotel records and stories lowered to portable IR and run on Triplex, with atomic observed-state guards.

entries.title: Field service
entries.summary: Equivalent TypeScript and Forma work-order models, checked for identical IR and run locally.

entries.title: Support desk
entries.summary: Tickets, references, escalation links, updates, negation and aggregate queries in Forma.

entries.title: Git / GitHub
entries.summary: Bundled Git and GitHub vocabularies: repositories, forks, branches, PRs, issues and local graph queries.

entries.title: Onboarded
entries.summary: Illustrative account language with checked scenarios, plus a TypeScript ontology and local Triplex transcript. The account checker is handwritten example code, not a Forma prelude.

entries.title: Stripe
entries.summary: Homepage pricing and billing language sketch. No Stripe prelude, API adapter or runnable pricing example ships in this repository.

entries.title: Salesforce
entries.summary: Homepage metadata language sketch. No Salesforce prelude or Metadata API compiler ships here.

entries.title: Palantir / Foundry
entries.summary: The bundled ontology language runs on Triplex. A separate open PR explores compiling portable models to Foundry Ontology as Code; it is not part of this checkout.

entries.title: Foldkit
entries.summary: Forma's Elm-style application prototype generates Foldkit and Effect TypeScript. It lives upstream in Forma; Open Ontology does not use Foldkit.

entries.title: Elm architecture
entries.summary: An upstream Forma prelude for Model / Message / update / view and checked command recovery. This is a Forma prototype targeting Foldkit, not an Elm compiler integration in this package.

entries.title: Effect
entries.summary: Effect 4.1.1 runs this package. Forma's separate Effect language checks services, typed failures and layers and generates TypeScript; that language is upstream, not an Open Ontology domain prelude.

entries.title: Okta
entries.summary: Homepage groups, rules and app-assignment sketch. No executable prelude or provider integration ships here.

entries.title: PagerDuty
entries.summary: Homepage on-call scheduling and escalation sketch. No executable prelude or provider integration ships here.

entries.title: Zapier
entries.summary: A workflows-as-code landing-page study. The page is published static content, not an executable Zapier prelude or deployer.

entries.title: Skills as a primitive
entries.summary: An open design exploration for skills as a first-class primitive, separate from the shipped ontology language.

entries.title: Prelude guides
entries.summary: A separate open PR proposes source landing pages for six bundled Lisp sources. This catalog indexes that work without treating it as merged.
